Setting include_document_structure populates the structured document tree on the result

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"include_document_structure\":true}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<article><h1>Heading</h1><p>Paragraph body.</p></article>", options);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
```
